sections.heading: Sign shapes and regulatory meanings
sections.markdown:
## Sign shapes and regulatory meanings

FACT_ID: sec08-F01 | anchor: A01
Drivers and bicyclists must obey official road signs and traffic signals unless an officer or emergency worker directs otherwise. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F02 | anchor: A01
The handbook describes 7 basic sign shapes and recommends recognizing shape and color early enough to respond from a distance. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F03 | anchor: A01
A tall rectangular sign generally gives a regulatory instruction that must be obeyed like a traffic law. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F04 | anchor: A01
A wide rectangular sign generally provides guidance such as a destination, direction or special information. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F05 | anchor: A01
A diamond-shaped warning sign identifies an actual or possible hazard on or beside the road; the described standard warning colors are yellow with black words or symbols. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F06 | anchor: A01
An eight-sided sign means stop. Make a complete stop at the marked stop line, or before the near-side crosswalk when there is no line. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F07 | anchor: A01
If a stop-controlled approach has neither a stop line nor a crosswalk, stop where approaching traffic can best be observed. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F08 | anchor: A01
After stopping, remain stopped for pedestrians crossing the side you will travel on and yield to traffic close enough to create a conflict before moving again. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F09 | anchor: A01
A round warning sign indicates a railroad crossing ahead. Slow, look, listen and prepare to stop; opening a window may help you hear a train. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F10 | anchor: A01
At a rail crossing, stop for an approaching train rather than trying to judge whether you can beat it. Passing at the crossing is prohibited. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F11 | anchor: A01
A triangular yield sign requires a speed appropriate for conditions and a stop when needed, at the marked line if one is present. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F12 | anchor: A01
After slowing or stopping at a yield sign, give way to vehicles in the intersection or approaching closely on the intersecting road. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F13 | anchor: A01
A five-sided sign warns of a school zone or school crossing; the handbook notes that these signs may be fluorescent green. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

FACT_ID: sec08-F14 | anchor: A01
The handbook places the described school warning sign from 150 through 700 feet before the school grounds or crossing. [A01]
Source: [A01 -> src:rdmv-ga-c:georgia-department-of-driver-services:handbook#pdf_page=29]

Misconceptions: A complete stop does not cancel a sign forbidding a red-light turn; an example speed applies to its signed location.
Mnemonic: Shape, meaning, condition, action.
Glossary: A regulatory sign controls conduct; a guide sign supplies route or location information; a warning sign announces a hazard.
Dynamic-fact isolation: Image rights and the completeness of visual-recognition coverage remain unresolved; verbal captions are the only authored knowledge source here.

items.skill: Recognize sign shapes and regulatory artwork
items.why: The source asks drivers to recognize shape and color from a distance. Textual meaning cards alone do not demonstrate visual recognition; a reviewed visual practice surface and cleared assets remain needed.

corpus_stability.reason: Revision frequency and legal-currentness are not independently established; retain release hold while authoring the dated source-grounded candidate.

verification_debt.claim_text: The dated handbook facts retain source freshness, rights and independent factual-review debt; no current-law equivalence or live service/fee policy is certified.
No handbook sign image is reproduced. Verbal captions support textual meaning facts, not a claim of complete image-recognition practice or visual asset clearance.
School-sign placement dimensions retain current standards confirmation; sample sign typography, arrows, artwork and exact color fidelity are not inferred from extraction.
